verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS back-office and compliance platform, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question for it. The evidence only describes managed services that Firstbase staff or partners perform, such as agency notifications, state expansion and extension filings. Nothing shows the user can define or schedule automations that run on their own, and probes found no public API or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
